title: 第12章 你算什么东西
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
茶州城街道上，人满为患，满是议论。

    只见路中央站着一名身着锦袍的男子，衣着华贵，面容倨傲，正笑吟吟地看着前面那被手下抓住的女子。

    “这般姿色，不去听春楼当头牌太可惜了！”他肆无忌惮地打量着对方，满是觊觎之色。

    那女子姿色上等，身姿玲珑，琼鼻樱唇，一副小家碧玉的灵秀模样，

    但此刻却被一名壮汉死死钳制着双臂，青丝凌乱散落在颊畔，表情惊慌……

    “放手！放开我！我要报官！”她疯狂挣扎，声嘶力竭。

    周遭百姓纷纷侧目，人人面露不忍。

    但即便如此，除了先前的张钰，却无人敢上前帮忙。

    “报官？”锦袍男子迟疑一声，随即放肆大笑：“哈哈哈，你真以为报官有用？”

    他上前，一只手猛地捏住女子纤细下巴，强迫她抬头对视，眸中尽是轻蔑与暴戾。

    “小美人，你怕是糊涂了。”

    “在这茶州，我袁决就是王法，就是天！”

    女子浑身剧颤，眼眶泛红，泪珠直打转。

    她初来乍到，哪曾想会遇到这种事情。

    此刻环顾四周，只见众人冷眼旁观，叫天天不应，叫地地不灵，简直绝望。

    袁决笑容更甚：“小美人，别挣扎了，等小爷我享受完了，会把你捧成听春楼头牌的。到时候，你的好日子就来了！”

    那女子闻言，更是花容失色。

    一想到自己今后要成为青楼女子，成为取悦他人的工具。

    她便如堕冰窖，恨不得咬牙自尽！

    “放手！”

    突然，一道声音突兀传来。

    袁决眉头一皱，神情有些烦躁。

    又是哪个不长眼的？

    他循声看去……

    此刻，陆舟已经来到场中。

    瞧见那绝望的女子，他眸光微闪，随即抬眸看向袁决，语气平静：“我的侍女，什么时候轮得到你带走了？”

    一语落地，周遭百姓皆是一惊。

    连那绝望的女子也猛地抬头，泪眼婆娑地望着身前突然出现的身影，满是错愕。

    袁决先是一怔，随即怒火中烧，扭了扭脖子，怒斥道：“你算什么东西？敢搅和你袁决爷爷的好事？”

    他上前两步，神情暴戾，恶声骂道：“老子管她是谁的人！别说只是你的侍女，就算是你妈，老子看中了，你也得乖乖给我洗干净了送上床，等着老子临幸！”

    此等污言秽语，不堪入耳！
content_en:
The streets of Chazhou City were crowded with people and full of discussions.

    I saw a man in a brocade robe standing in the middle of the road. He was luxuriously dressed and had a haughty face. He was looking at the woman in front of him who was caught by his men with a smile.

    "With such beauty, it would be a pity not to listen to Chunlou's lead!" He looked at the other party unscrupulously, full of covetousness.

    The woman was of high-class beauty, with a delicate figure, a beautiful nose and lips, and a graceful appearance like Xiaojiabiyu.

    But at this moment, his arms were tightly restrained by a strong man, his black hair was messy on his cheeks, his expression was panic...

    "Let go! Let me go! I want to report to the police!" She struggled wildly, shouting at the top of her lungs.

    The people around him looked at him sideways, showing their unbearable expressions.

    But even so, no one dared to step forward to help except Zhang Yu from before.

    "Reporting to the official?" The man in brocade robe hesitated, then laughed wildly: "Hahaha, do you really think reporting to the official is useful?"

    He stepped forward, grabbed the woman's slender chin with one hand, and forced her to look up at her, his eyes full of contempt and violence.

    "Little beauty, I'm afraid you are confused."

    "In this Chazhou, I, Yuan Jue, am King Fa and Heaven!"

    The woman's whole body was trembling, her eyes were red, and her tears were rolling.

    When she first arrived, she never imagined that she would encounter such a thing.

    Looking around at this moment, I saw everyone watching with cold eyes, calling the sky and the earth for not responding, and the earth and the earth for not working. It was so despairing.

    Yuan Jue smiled even more: "Little beauty, stop struggling. When I finish enjoying it, I will make you the top one in Tingchun House. Then, your good days will come!"

    When the woman heard this, her beauty turned pale.

    The thought of becoming a brothel girl in the future and a tool to please others.

    She felt like she had fallen into an ice cellar, wishing she could bite her teeth and commit suicide!

    "Let go!"

    Suddenly, a voice came unexpectedly.

    Yuan Jue frowned, looking a little irritable.

    Who doesn’t have eyesight?

    He followed the sound and looked...

    At this moment, Lu Zhou has arrived at the venue.

    Seeing the desperate woman, his eyes flashed slightly, then he raised his eyes to look at Yuan Jue, and said in a calm tone: "My maid, when will it be your turn to take her away?"

    As soon as the words fell to the ground, the people around him were shocked.

    Even the desperate woman suddenly raised her head, looking at the figure that suddenly appeared in front of her with tearful eyes, full of surprise.

    Yuan Jue was startled at first, and then he became angry, twisted his neck, and angrily shouted: "Who do you think you are? Dare to interfere with your grandpa Yuan Jue's good deeds?"

    He took two steps forward, looked violent, and cursed viciously: "I don't care who she is! Don't say she is just your maid, even if it is your mother, if I like her, you have to clean her up and put her to bed, and wait for me to be lucky!"

    Such filthy words are unbearable!
title_en: Chapter 12 Who do you think you are?
